rule: On screen, no identity mark draws its capitals under 14 px, and no tagline inside a lockup sets under 13 px. In print, no capitals under 3 mm and no tagline under 7 pt. Each lockup names its replacement below its minimum. Favicons use the ampersand's 16 px master.
